sub_categories.name: Game Engines & Gameplay
sub_categories.description: Building games and gameplay systems — game engines, Godot/GDScript, Unity ECS/DOTS, multiplayer netcode and physics.

skills.name: game-engine
skills.description: Expert skill for building web-based game engines and games using HTML5, Canvas, WebGL, and JavaScript. Use when asked to create games, build game engines, implement game physics, handle collision detection, set up game loops, manage sprites, add game controls, or work with 2D/3D rendering. Covers techniques for platformers, breakout-style games, maze games, tilemaps, audio, multiplayer via WebRTC, and publishing games.

skills.name: multiplayer-game
skills.description: Pragmatic patterns for building multiplayer games: matchmaking, tick loops, realtime state, interest management, and validation.

skills.name: godot-gdscript-patterns
skills.description: Master Godot 4 GDScript patterns including signals, scenes, state machines, and optimization. Use when building Godot games, implementing game systems, or learning GDScript best practices.

skills.name: unity-ecs-patterns
skills.description: Master Unity ECS (Entity Component System) with DOTS, Jobs, and Burst for high-performance game development. Use when building data-oriented games, optimizing performance, or working with large entity counts.

sub_categories.name: 3D & WebGL Graphics
sub_categories.description: Real-time 3D and shader work — Three.js/WebGL/WebGPU scenes, materials, lighting and GLSL shaders.

skills.name: threejs-animation
skills.description: Three.js animation - keyframe animation, skeletal animation, morph targets, animation mixing. Use when animating objects, playing GLTF animations, creating procedural motion, or blending animations.

skills.name: threejs-fundamentals
skills.description: Three.js scene setup, cameras, renderer, Object3D hierarchy, coordinate systems. Use when setting up 3D scenes, creating cameras, configuring renderers, managing object hierarchies, or working with transforms.

skills.name: threejs-geometry
skills.description: Three.js geometry creation - built-in shapes, BufferGeometry, custom geometry, instancing. Use when creating 3D shapes, working with vertices, building custom meshes, or optimizing with instanced rendering.

skills.name: threejs-interaction
skills.description: Three.js interaction - raycasting, controls, mouse/touch input, object selection. Use when handling user input, implementing click detection, adding camera controls, or creating interactive 3D experiences.

skills.name: threejs-lighting
skills.description: Three.js lighting - light types, shadows, environment lighting. Use when adding lights, configuring shadows, setting up IBL, or optimizing lighting performance.

skills.name: threejs-loaders
skills.description: Three.js asset loading - GLTF, textures, images, models, async patterns. Use when loading 3D models, textures, HDR environments, or managing loading progress.

skills.name: threejs-materials
skills.description: Three.js materials - PBR, basic, phong, shader materials, material properties. Use when styling meshes, working with textures, creating custom shaders, or optimizing material performance.

skills.name: threejs-postprocessing
skills.description: Three.js post-processing - EffectComposer, bloom, DOF, screen effects. Use when adding visual effects, color grading, blur, glow, or creating custom screen-space shaders.

skills.name: threejs-shaders
skills.description: Three.js shaders - GLSL, ShaderMaterial, uniforms, custom effects. Use when creating custom visual effects, modifying vertices, writing fragment shaders, or extending built-in materials.

skills.name: threejs-textures
skills.description: Three.js textures - texture types, UV mapping, environment maps, texture settings. Use when working with images, UV coordinates, cubemaps, HDR environments, or texture optimization.

sub_categories.name: Creative & Generative Coding
sub_categories.description: Algorithmic and generative art and interactive canvas experiences (p5.js, flow fields, seeded randomness).

skills.name: algorithmic-art
skills.description: Creating algorithmic art using p5.js with seeded randomness and interactive parameter exploration. Use this when users request creating art using code, generative art, algorithmic art, flow fields, or particle systems. Create original algorithmic art rather than copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

sub_categories.name: Other
sub_categories.description: Game/graphics skills that do not fit the above subcategories.
